description: Browse experience: /shop (client with Suspense-wrapped useSearchParams), /shop/[categorySlug] (server, delegates to the shared ProductGrid), and /product/[id] (server with a client ProductActions child). All use the shared ProductCard/ProductGrid from FEAT-001.
steps: Rewrite c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\src\app\(public)\shop\page.tsx as 'use client'. Export a default ShopPage that returns <Suspense fallback={<ShopSkeleton/>}><ShopContent/></Suspense>. ShopContent reads useSearchParams() for search, categorySlug, featured and passes them as initialSearch/initialCategorySlug/initialFeatured to <ProductGrid /> (from FEAT-001). Wrap useSearchParams in Suspense so the route prerenders cleanly (this is required once Cache Components is off, because useSearchParams otherwise blocks static generation).

Rewrite c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\src\app\(public)\shop\[categorySlug]\page.tsx as an async SERVER component with `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`. Await params to get categorySlug; fetch the category name via prisma.category.findUnique({where:{slug:categorySlug}}). Render a breadcrumb (হোম / শপ / {name}) and <ProductGrid categorySlug={slug} fixedCategory initialCategorySlug={slug} />. If the category is null, still render the grid (it will show empty state) but keep the breadcrumb generic.

Rewrite c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\src\app\(public)\product\[id]\page.tsx as an async SERVER component with `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`. Await params for id; const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({where:{id}, include:{category:{include:{parent:true}}}}). If !product render a centered not-found block: 'পণ্যটি পাওয়া যায়নি' + a link to /shop. Otherwise cast images=(product.images as string[]) ?? [], compute inStock = product.stock>0, and render: breadcrumb (হোম / শপ / [category] / [name]); two-column layout — left image gallery (main next/image + thumbnail row, emoji fallback when empty), right info (name, price via formatCurrency, stock badge — green 'স্টক আছে (n unit)' when inStock else red 'স্টক নেই', description, category, SKU, barcode, unit); then <ProductActions product={...serializable shape} /> ; related products = prisma.product.findMany({where:{categoryId:product.categoryId, stock:{gt:0}, id:{not:product.id}}, include:{category:true}, take:4}) rendered as ProductCard. Pass ProductActions a plain object {id,name,sellPrice,stock,unit}.

Create c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\src\components\product-actions.tsx ('use client'): props { product:{id,name,sellPrice,stock,unit} }. Local qty state (1..Math.floor(stock), disabled when out of stock). 'কার্টে যোগ করুন' calls useCartStore.addItem({id,name,price:sellPrice,image:null,qty,unit}) + toast.success. 'এখনই কিনুন' does the same addItem then router.push('/checkout'). Disable both when stock<=0. Use useRouter from next/navigation.
acceptance_criteria: /shop is a client component that wraps useSearchParams in a <Suspense> boundary and renders <ProductGrid/>.
/shop/[categorySlug] is a server component with force-dynamic that awaits params and renders <ProductGrid categorySlug fixedCategory />.

/product/[id] is a server component with force-dynamic that fetches via prisma and renders a client <ProductActions/>; out-of-stock shows the product with a red স্টক নেই badge and disabled buttons; missing product shows পণ্যটি পাওয়া যায়নি.
verification: After FEAT-004 and FEAT-005 are also done, run `npm run build` and confirm the /shop, /shop/[categorySlug], and /product/[id] routes compile and the build exits 0.
findings:
FEAT-003 browse complete. `npx prisma generate` then `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0. What later steps / reviewers need to know:

- /shop (src/app/(public)/shop/page.tsx, 'use client'): default ShopPage returns <Suspense fallback={<ShopSkeleton/>}><ShopContent/></Suspense>. ShopContent calls useSearchParams() and reads `search`, `categorySlug`, `featured` (=featured==='true'), passing them as initialSearch/initialCategorySlug/initialFeatured to <ProductGrid/>. No force-dynamic on /shop (the Suspense boundary is what lets useSearchParams prerender cleanly now that Cache Components is off). ProductGrid owns the rest (filters, sort, pagination, fetch). The navbar search box navigates here via /shop?search=...; the homepage featured/new-arrivals সব দেখুন links here via /shop?featured=true and /shop?sort=newest (sort has no initial prop on ProductGrid, so /shop?sort=newest just loads the grid's default 'newest' sort — accepted).

- /shop/[categorySlug] (server, force-dynamic): awaits params, prisma.category.findUnique({where:{slug}}) for the name (falls back to the slug when null), renders a breadcrumb (হোম / শপ / {name}) then <ProductGrid categorySlug={slug} fixedCategory initialCategorySlug={slug}/>. NOTE: the shared ProductGrid always renders its own h1 'সকল পণ্য' (it has no title prop and FEAT-003 did not modify it — it is FEAT-001's component and changing it would also alter /shop). So on a category page the breadcrumb shows the category name while the grid header still reads 'সকল পণ্য'; this is the literal spec behavior, not a bug to fix in this FEAT.

- /product/[id] (server, force-dynamic): awaits params, prisma.product.findUnique({where:{id}, include:{category:{include:{parent:true}}}}). Not found → centered 'পণ্যটি পাওয়া যায়নি' + link to /shop. Otherwise casts images=(product.images as string[]) (Array.isArray check), inStock=stock>0, renders breadcrumb (হোম / শপ / [parent?] / [category] / name with category+parent links pointing to /shop/[slug] per FEAT-002's segment form), a two-column layout: left = image gallery (main next/image fill + thumbnail row when images>1, 🪑 emoji fallback when empty), right = name, price via formatCurrency, stock badge (green 'স্টক আছে (n unit)' when inStock else red 'স্টক নেই'), description, info grid (category link / একক unit / SKU / বারকোড), then <ProductActions>. Related = prisma.product.findMany({where:{categoryId:product.categoryId, stock:{gt:0}, id:{not:product.id}}, include:{category:true}, take:4}) mapped to ProductCard shape and rendered as <ProductCard>. The gallery is rendered server-side (static main image = images[0], static thumbnail previews) — ProductActions is the ONLY new client component created this FEAT, so no client gallery state / click-to-swap (the spec lists only product-actions.tsx as the new file and mandates a server page). Seed products have images:[] so the emoji fallback is the common render path.

- ProductActions (src/components/product-actions.tsx, 'use client'): props { product:{id,name,sellPrice,stock,unit} } (exported type ProductActionsProduct). qty state clamped 1..Math.max(1,Math.floor(stock)); minus/plus disabled when !inStock. 'কার্টে যোগ করুন' → useCartStore.addItem({id,name,price:sellPrice,image:null,qty,unit}) + toast.success(`${name} কার্টে যোগ হয়েছে!`), label switches to 'স্টক নেই' when out of stock (matches ProductCard convention). 'এখনই কিনুন' → same addItem then useRouter().push('/checkout'). Both buttons disabled when stock<=0. image is always null here (the detail page does not pass the image URL into ProductActions; the cart line item image is only decorative and the ProductCard already sets it for grid adds).

- Unit handling: Product.unit is the Prisma `Unit` enum (PIECE/KG/LITER/METER); it is assignable to string (FEAT-002 already relies on this) and is passed straight through to both ProductActions and the badge/info text (e.g. 'স্টক আছে (5 PIECE)'). stock is Float; the qty selector floors it.

- Build status: `npx tsc --noEmit` is green. `npm run build` is still expected to fail until FEAT-004/005 land (the not-yet-rewritten /cart, /checkout, /orders client pages and the /orders/[orderId] page still use useSearchParams/use(params) without a Suspense boundary). No config change was needed — next.config.ts already has cacheComponents:false + partialPrefetching:false from FEAT-001.

- Off-limits respected: did not modify prisma/**, src/lib/prisma.ts, src/lib/utils.ts, src/lib/auth.ts, src/middleware.ts, src/app/admin/**, src/app/api/**, src/app/layout.tsx, src/components/ui/*, prisma/seed.ts. Only new files created + the three storefront page files rewritten.
